findings: A Sequence of Impulses,clarinet,saxophone(alto and soprano)and piano,is a three-player chamber work with saxophone doubling.
Seven continuously connected sections portray situations and emotions around impulse,such as desire,conflict and patience. Duration13:50.
Premiere18May2017,21st Century Music Society14thconcert,Tokyo Bunka Kaikan Small Hall:Rie Arima clarinet,Hiromi Hara saxophone,composer Kae Hirakawa piano.
Zen-On590247,ISBN9784115902473,print release15June2024,48score+12pages each of2parts; digital64pages. This release date is distinct from2017work date.

score_observations: Inspected printedpp4–6:opening3/4 quarter124,sparse offbeat notes and rests in winds; slap-tongue label and symbols,short slurred chromatic sixteenth-note bursts,and strongly independent piano gestures.

Bybar27,wind parts have rapid chromatic descending runs and Fz indications; meter shifts common time then3/4. Preview alto part reaches several ledger lines above staff. Soprano switching location is outside inspected pages.
